svg.title: 18. Diagonal neck stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Relax your shoulders and turn your head about halfway to one side. Lower your chin towards that armpit. Hold a light stretch at the opposite back corner of your neck.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://myhealth.alberta.ca/health/tests-treatments/pages/conditions.aspx?hwid=acl1102
